QuestInfo.name: In Phantom's Name
QuestInfo.0: Shati wanted to share her father's wealth with the poor, but how could it be done without making bandits look bad? Perhaps Jano had an idea.
QuestInfo.1: Jano suggests using Phantom's name for stealing Tigun's wealth.  He thinks if he can steal Tigun's wealth and leave a #rforged Phantom's#k letter, people will believe it was Phantom who has stolen everything...
QuestInfo.2: At Jano's suggestion, Alpha and Beta stole Tigun's Wealth and left a letter blaming it on Phantom.

1.conditionContent: Steal Tigun's riches from Tigun's House.

0.0: I know we work for the people of Ariant, but this is too much. We can't let the reputation of the Sand Bandits be the same as petty thieves.
0.1: How about we steal everything in the name of Phantom! He steals stuff all the time, so nobody would get mad!

yes.0: First, sneak into #bTigun's House#k and steal his riches. Then, leave this #rForged Phantom Letter#k there to make everyone think it was Phantom's handiwork.

no.0: If you don't like it, so be it. But I will not let you use the name of the Sand Bandits.

1.0: Did you take care of my request?
1.1: Thankfully he was at work all day today. Thanks so much!

default.0: Steal all of daddy's wealth from my house and give them to me. I want to help the poor.

npc.0: Sneak into #bTigun's House#k and steal his riches. Then, leave this #rforged Phantom Letter#k there to make everyone think it was Phantom's handiwork.

lost.0: You lost the letter? You're clumsier than I thought. Don't you lose it next time.
